subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary In recent years the world's climate is undergoing a significant change. This is happening because of the gradual increasing of heat in the atmosphere. CFC gas is mainly responsible for this global warming . Climatologists predict that by midway through the next century temperatures may have risen 4c. If this happens the southern part of Bangladesh may go under water. 153  Title : The Kind Lion and the Mouse See Dhaka Residential Model College. Sl. No. 17; Page No. 64
